ache.title: “Tier 0 healer”: how a nice unit becomes a must
ache.note: Cocoa is pitched as a ‘versatile Tier 0 healer and tank’ with three builds and advice on which banner to prioritize. ‘Tier 0’ makes a support sound mandatory, and ‘which banner first’ assumes you’re pulling on more than one. Healers are lovely. A ranking label shouldn’t decide whether you need one.
ache.tip: Ask whether your current team actually struggles. If it doesn’t, Tier 0 is just a word on a chart.
lines: tier 0 is a sticker, not a law
healers heal. pulling for them hurts
your team is doing fine, promise
